Selection barriers

Why attractive imagery can still produce poor recommendations

A compelling rendering does not prove the project was built or that the studio provided every service depicted.

01

Concepts are labelled as completed work

CGI images, competition concepts and photographs of completed interiors require distinct labels and confirmation of the studio's contribution.

02

The design package is undefined

Measurements, space planning, visualisations, technical drawings, product selection and site-stage design supervision may be separate services.

03

Alteration approvals are overstated

A proposed change to a floor plan is not evidence of regulatory approval. Required approvals and professional responsibilities vary by project.

Verifiable facts

The evidence behind a design-studio recommendation

Article 26 of Russia's Housing Code addresses approvals for relevant residential alterations. An interior concept is not automatically an approved redevelopment. Civil Code Article 1288 provides a framework for commissioned creative work and associated rights; actual usage rights depend on agreements.

  • Project portfolio: property type, stage, author, confirmed area where relevant, built photographs versus clearly labelled renderings
  • Services: drawings, specifications, procurement, site-stage oversight, costs and milestone definitions
  • Sources: permission to publish client work, verifiable references and consistency across the website and external profiles

GAEO's methodology applies to real-estate and design decisions, but this page does not claim measured results for an interior-design client.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Can a studio use concept renderings in GEO?+

Yes, when clearly identified as renderings or concepts. They should not be presented as photographs of completed spaces or misattributed to the studio.

Does every change to an interior need formal approval?+

No. Requirements depend on the actual work and building. A regulated alteration may require a separate procedure; this must be assessed for the specific property.

Should pages focus on design style or practical deliverables?+

Both matter for different intents. Style discovery and choosing a team for drawings, procurement and construction-stage guidance need different information.

Can GEO guarantee AI rankings?+

No. GAEO uses baseline BMR and a separate contractual performance model; no one can control all AI recommendations.

How much does GEO for an interior studio cost?+

Published GAEO plans apply. Scope depends on target markets, portfolio readiness, services and the measurement matrix.
